author: GitHub
description:
Can refusing to use AI tools cost you a job offer? In this clip from the GitHub Podcast, the team discusses recent interview trends where candidates are turned down for not using AI in their workflows. They explore why company culture, product alignment, and tool adoption play a big role in hiring decisions. Watch the full podcast episode to hear how developers can navigate AI conversations in tech interviews.
